passages.provision_quote: It is the policy of the state that eligible renewable energy resources and zero-carbon resources supply 100 percent of all retail sales of electricity to California end-use customers and 100 percent of electricity procured to serve all state agencies by December 31, 2045.
passages.note: Enacted bill text sets a 100% clean energy mandate with a firm December 31, 2045 deadline.
Assembly floor vote record shows Gabriel among the Ayes on SB 100's final Assembly passage.
passages.tally_quote: Ayes Count 44 Noes Count 33 NVR Count 3

rows.reasoning: Gabriel voted Aye on SB 100 (2017-2018) in the Assembly floor vote on 2018-08-28, a vote from his earlier term in this legislature. The enacted law's Section 454.53(a) requires that clean and zero-carbon resources 'supply 100 percent of all retail sales of electricity to California end-use customers ... by December 31, 2045,' and Section 399.15 sets firm interim procurement percentages by specific dates, matching the rung text 'Require a shift to clean energy through mandates and firm deadlines.'
